channel.title: Titel Media GmbH - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: New Balance Made the Perfect Beige Dad Shoe
item.description: New Balance's 740 dad shoe releases in "Dockside," essentially a clean beige take on the sneaker.

item.title: adidas' Best British Sneaker Looks Better Handmade In Germany
item.description: adidas' all-white Manchester sneaker is making its comeback in a very big & very crisp way.

item.title: Another Casually Classy Pair of Loafers From Used-to-Be Sneaker Brand Converse
item.description: Converse’s Jack Purcell 1935 Loafer is classy, casual, & comes accompanied by optional tassels to fit to the vamp, so you can up the loafer levels to your liking

item.title: Shine Bright Like A Diamond(-Bedazzled Samba)
item.description: The Samba is definitely still worth your attention. Take the adidas Samba Rhinestone Black, which puts the spotlight firmly back on the silhouette.

item.title: Playboi Carti Made Your Dad's Favorite Skate Brand Cool Again
item.description: This is how Playboi Carti quietly revived No Fear for the modern day. Thank Carti's Opium for helping rebrand the Y2K streetwear brand as something newly edgy.

item.title: Patta Knows Itself
item.description: Patta's Spring/Summer 2026 sees the brand reconnect with its roots through nostalgic graphics & staple pieces.

item.title: Nike's Beautiful “Hydrangeas” Air Jordans Are Already in Full Bloom
item.description: The Air Jordan 10 "Hydrangeas" emerges as this soft, spring-worthy take on the classic & tough sneaker.

item.title: Jordan’s Greatest Sneaker Isn’t Just Cool. It’s an Ice-Cold Star
item.description: The classic Air Jordan 1 sneaker heads to All-Star Weekend 2026 in the iconic "Cool Grey" colorway & luxe details.

item.title: adidas’ Woven Ballet Sneaker Treats Ballerina Toes to Some Fresh Air
item.description: adidas' Taekwondo Mei gets a basketweave treatment. The results are a breezy summer-ready take on the ballet-coded sneaker.

item.title: To Make This Absurdly Suave adidas Sneaker, It Took Stone Roses & Manchester United
item.description: Stone Roses, Manchester United, & adidas collaborate on the Tobacco sneaker, designing easily one of the cleanest versions yet.
